'''''Herniaria algarvica''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Caryophyllaceae]], [[endemic]] to southwestern coastal [[Portugal]]. It inhabits clearings of scrub in maritime cliffs, rocks and coastal dunes.<ref name="iucn status 20 November 2021" />
